src: The Moon's orbit around the Earth intersects with the ecliptic in places called the ascending node and the descending node. If the Moon's orbit around the Earth is aligned to the ecliptic level, an eclipse will necessarily occur at the end of each lunar month, and a lunar eclipse will occur at the middle of each lunar month, but the Moon's shadow will not fall to the Earth until the Moon is at or near one of its two nodes, indicating that the eclipse period is related to the difference in the two apparent magnitudes of the Moon and the Moon, so that the longest period of total eclipse occurs when the Moon is at the center (closest to the Earth) and the Earth is at the farthest (farthest from the Sun).

src: , abbreviated to "UGTA" (from French: Union générale des travailleurs algériens) is a trade union in Algeria founded on 24 February 1956 during the French occupation of Algeria with the aim of mobilising Algerian workers against the interests of colonial and capitalist France.
